params.caption:
🚨 Ubisoft lays off 166 more staff — right after calling its biggest game of the year a win.

Ubisoft has cut 166 jobs at its Montreal and Quebec City studios, affecting staff who couldn't be reassigned after projects were cancelled or rescoped. The company says it's "adjusting the size of some teams to ensure our resources are aligned with current production priorities and business needs."

The timing stings: CEO Yves Guillemot just said Q2 results "exceeded our expectations, driven by the continued success of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced" — net bookings hit €389M, beating €370M guidance. Ubisoft's headcount has still fallen by roughly 1,100 people over the past six months.

🕐 Published 08:00 GMT+3

📰 Sources: PC Gamer, Kotaku, TechSpot

👥 Follow: x.com/Ubisoft, x.com/pcgamer
